minimum_definition_for_higher_memory_can: candidate MemTotal_kB must be strictly greater than 16372440; this is only a topology-ordering guard and is not an extrapolated 32769 memory requirement
interpretation: The canonical hosted reference job ran on an ubuntu-24.04 hosted compute agent with MemTotal 16,372,440 kB and SwapTotal 3,145,724 kB. During the canonical 16385 role probe MemAvailable and SwapFree reached zero and the process/runner terminated under memory exhaustion. This authority freezes the physical-memory envelope only; it does not estimate the memory required by 32769. A 32769 high-memory candidate must first have strictly greater MemTotal and must still pass its own measured response-blind lifecycle pilot.
